subject.title: Feishu: replied/quoted message mentions show as raw @_user_N placeholders

question: Should maintainers set aside the conflicting broad fork PR and queue a fresh Feishu-only repair for fetched quoted/thread mention normalization?
rationale: The source-level defect and fix boundary are clear, but an open cross-repo PR still claims this issue with closing syntax and uses the same broad conflicting head as the closed same-repo PR that was reviewed as unmergeable.

options.title: Queue a fresh narrow repair
options.body: Close or ignore the broad fork candidate and implement only the fetched-message mention adapter, normalization call, and focused Feishu tests from current main.

options.title: Adopt a narrowed fork diff
options.body: Preserve contributor work only if the fork branch can be reduced to the Feishu parser and test changes without unrelated security, session, dependency, or changelog churn.

options.title: Leave to Feishu owner
options.body: Keep this open for the Feishu plugin owner to fix manually with live workspace proof when ready.

recommendation.title: Queue a fresh narrow repair
recommendation.body: Close or ignore the broad fork candidate and implement only the fetched-message mention adapter, normalization call, and focused Feishu tests from current main.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata declares this handle as the Feishu/Lark plugin contact, and the decision is confined to that plugin boundary.
